Title: BRIEF SCHEMA — scc-resolution-case
Text: Use this skill when WORKING_ITEMS needs to create or update a PKG-00 SCC case file.

Title: Required Fields
Text: ```yaml PURPOSE: Create or update one SCC resolution case. RequestedBy: WORKING_ITEMS ScopePath: /abs/path/to/DEL-00-XX_... TaskSkill: scc-resolution-case ApplyEdits: true AllowedWriteTargets:   - /abs/path/to/DEL-00-XX_.../scc-cases/<case-folder>/   - /abs/path/to/DEL-00-XX_.../_run_records/ RuntimeOverrides:   CASE_ID: CASE-SCC-002   CASE_PATH: /abs/path/to/DEL-00-XX_.../scc-cases/<case-folder>   CASE_TITLE: SCC-002 PKG-10 Policy Proposal   SCC_ID: SCC-002   DEPCLOSURE_SNAPSHOT: /abs/path/to/execution/_Reconciliation/DepClosure/CLOSURE_...   AFFECTED_DELIVERABLES: DEL-10-02;DEL-10-03   CASE_STATE: OPEN_FOR_TASK_WORK ExpectedOutputs:   - Case_Contract.md   - Case_Datasheet.md   - Task_Findings.csv   - Evidence_Register.csv   - Candidate_Remedies.csv   - Ruling_Register.csv   - Open_Questions.md   - Owner_Workflow_Handoff.md   - Case_QA.md ```

Title: Optional Runtime Overrides
Text: - `SEED_PACKET_PATHS` — semicolon-separated paths to prior packets to preserve under `case-seeds/`. - `SCC_NODE_SET` — semicolon-separated SCC node set. - `FOCUS_PAIRS` — semicolon-separated bidirectional pairs.

Title: Required Custom Instructions
Text: - Treat existing scope-change packets as seed evidence, not active SCOPE_CHANGE intake. - Do not edit product deliverables, dependency registers, decomposition files, `_ScopeChange/`, or `_Reconciliation/`. - Do not report SCC closure or project-wide blocked/unblocked status.
